title: one-page-run-archive-soren
body:
One-page run archive (personal quick sheet) - purpose: compact record of short latency/cost runs, used as my morning reference when iterating batch/kv-cache/quant settings.

TABLE (csv-style):
run_id,date,model,quant,bs,seq_len,total_tokens,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,notes
R001,2025-11-03,redwood-v1-7b,fp16,1,128,12k,28,54,0.23,base baseline on single GPU (no cache)
R012,2025-11-12,redwood-v1-7b,int8,1,128,12k,22,40,0.14,quantized int8 perf win, some small hallucination uptick in evals
R017,2025-12-02,redwood-v1-7b,int8,4,128,48k,45,92,0.08,continuous batching 4x, p95 increases but cost drops 6x vs single
R038,2026-01-08,redwood-v1-13b,fp16,1,256,24k,48,110,0.45,longer seq, model 13b p50 double 7b
R045,2026-01-22,redwood-v1-7b,int8+kv,1,256,24k,20,38,0.11,kv prefix caching enabled — big p50 win on repeated prefixes
R051,2026-02-14,redwood-v1-7b,int8+kv,8,256,192k,70,150,0.02,batch 8 with cache maintained per-request. watch memory regen on 13b
R058,2026-02-28,gptj-6b,fp16,2,128,24k,35,78,0.19,control model for generation quality compare
R062,2026-03-02,redwood-v1-7b,int8+kv,2,512,48k,33,76,0.09,larger seq_len, batching 2, cache hit rate ~0.42

Quick summary:
- Best single-request p50: int8 + kv caching (R045) — improved tail when prefix repeats.
- Best cost per 1k tokens: large-batch runs (R051) show unit cost drops but latency tail worsens.
- Tradeoffs: batching reduces cost but increases p95; caching reduces p50 significantly when workload has repeated prefixes.

Top anomalies / flags to follow up:
- R017 p95 jumped unexpectedly on batch 4 despite similar token distribution — may be kernel scheduling on the node, file a small repro.
- R038 memory pressure on 13b with 256 seq occasionally caused OOM warnings; check model compilation flags for fused attention.

Hypotheses (for next week):
- H1: Combining moderate batching (bs=2) with kv cache yields best p50/cost balance for chat-like workloads.
- H2: Int8 gives cost wins with acceptable quality; enable quant-aware evals across eval-suite-2 to confirm regression risk <1%.

Immediate next actions:
- Re-run R017 with CPU pinning disabled and the latest kernel patch (ticket: ENG-1423) to see if p95 stabilizes. (owner: Soren)
- Add a quick eval run for R062 outputs against eval-suite-2 (Leah) to check hallucination delta.
- Small repro script for 13b OOM to post in #infra-ooms (Kai)

Notes to self / habits:
- Keep this file one page. Move long-form notes to a confluence draft.
- Use run_id pattern prefix with month for quick grouping.
- Snapshot top-3 runs into team notes before any rollout changes.

Raw commands snippets for repro (copy into terminal):
- baseline: ./run_infer --model redwood-v1-7b --quant int8 --batch 1 --seq 128 --prompt-file sample_batch.txt --log-latency
- batch-8-cache: ./run_infer --model redwood-v1-7b --quant int8 --batch 8 --seq 256 --kv-cache yes --trace off

End of sheet.
summary: compact personal run log and action list for quick iteration on batching/kv-cache/quant experiments
